fusions.name: Patient Bite
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to this blow of 16 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Paralytic Spit
fusions.desc: Casts a link that deals 9 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and knocks it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Coil and Wait
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Gets Through
fusions.desc: Your poison attacks ignore 25% of the target's armour. It also reduces the cooldown of every other ability you have by 5%.
